items.html: Nukva of ZA in the place of Abba, as it is written, “by wisdom founded the earth,” as “Father founded his daughter.” It is also the meaning of “Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore, for it is holy.” “Keep,” which is the Nukva becomes “holy,” which is Abba. This is the meaning of the text “it is holy,” because the Nekeva returns to being holy, and Beria rose in Ima, as you know that Ima nests in her abdomen.” Also, Yetzira in the place of ZA because ZA nests in the angel and Assiya in Nukva de ZA because Malchut nests in the Ofan, which is Assiya.
